tabs.label: Event Highlights
tabs.description: Explore workshops, sessions, and partner activities from RoboFest 2025.

events.title: ROS2 Humble Workshop
paragraphs: Join the exciting "Robots in Action with ROS2" workshop, part of RoboFest 2025, organized by TechTics Club to take your robotics knowledge beyond just coding! | 📍 Venue: Beaconhouse PECHS Campus | 📅 Dates: 27–28 September | 🎯 Format: Live Session

What You'll Learn: | - ROS 2 Humble – The latest version of the Robot Operating System | - Edge AI – Learn how AI works on the edge | - Embedded Systems – Merge software with hardware | - Simulators – Test and develop robotics virtually | - Bio-Inspired Swarm Robots – Design intelligent cooperative systems

Led by Team Brainswarm Robotics, this hands-on workshop is designed to empower young minds with practical skills and insights that go far beyond programming. Dive into real-world robotics and experience the fusion of innovation and automation.
Register now by scanning the QR code on the poster or visit RoboFest 2025 Workshop Registeration. | 📞 Contact: 0325-8988646
Don’t miss this opportunity to witness the future of robotics!

events.title: Imagine Cup Awareness Session
paragraphs: Get a chance to learn about Imagine Cup from the MLSC DHA Sufa Student Ambassador team. | This session will give you insights into the Imagine Cup, a global tech startup competition, and the | opportunities it opens for students worldwide. | 📍 Venue: Beaconhouse PECHS Campus | 📅 Dates: 28th September | 🎯 Format: Live Session

Join us to explore how you can unlock networking opportunities, global recognition, and expert coaching. | Prepare yourself for the Imagine Cup 2026 and get ready to share your ideas and bring your startup to life!
Don’t miss the chance to kickstart your tech journey!
Register now by scanning the QR code on the poster or visit Imagine Cup Registration.

events.title: SSFH x Algorithmics at RoboFest
paragraphs: Explore the world of tech with SSFH & Algorithmics at RoboFest 2025! | 🔹 Take part in a Tech + Islamic Quiz | 🔹 Join the TinkerCad Challenge | 🔹 Try our Python Puzzle Race | 🔹 Watch Algorithmic LMS Live in action | 🔹 Build circuits in our hands-on mini challenge | 🔹 Snap photos with techy props | 🎁 Win cool giveaways & trial sessions! | 📍 Venue: Beaconhouse PECHS Campus | 📅 Date: 27 September | 🔗 techticsclub.com

events.title: SSFH x Algorithmics at RoboFest
paragraphs: Join us for exciting activities at RoboFest 2025 with SSFH and Algorithmics! | 📍 Venue: Beaconhouse PECHS Campus | 📅 Date: 28 September | 🎯 Format: Live Sessions

What You'll Learn: | - Build your first app using MIT App Inventor | - Compete in our Math & Logic Relay | - Solve Snap Coding Sprints | - Explore cool AI & Web Dev projects | - Quiz on Tech & Sunnah | - Discover Algorithmic student creations | - Grab giveaways & win a free trial class!
